gloss: end of a book; back matter; appendix section

definitions.gloss: end of a book; back of a volume; back matter
definitions.explanation: The final pages or section of a book or volume, where appendices, indexes, or afterwords are typically found.

examples.japanese: {巻末|かんまつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{索引|さくいん}→索引：04168_sakuin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is an index at the end of the book.

examples.japanese: {巻末|かんまつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{付録|ふろく}→付録：06206_furoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{参照|さんしょう}→参照：11866_sanshou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please refer to the appendix at the back of the book.

examples.japanese: {巻末|かんまつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{著者|ちょしゃ}→著者：03501_chosha⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧⟦あとがき→あとがき：21507_atogaki⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{参考文献|さんこうぶんけん}→参考文献：09288_sankoubunken⟧⟦リスト→リスト：09786_risuto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{掲載|けいさい}→掲載：08993_keisai⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The back of the book contains an afterword by the author and a bibliography.

notes:
Composed of {巻|かん} (volume, scroll) + {末|まつ} (end). Refers to the back portion of a book or publication where supplementary material is placed.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {巻末|かんまつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{付録|ふろく}→付録：06206_furoku⟧: appendix at the end of a book
- {巻末|かんまつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{索引|さくいん}→索引：04168_sakuin⟧: index at the back
- {巻末|かんまつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{収録|しゅうろく}→収録：08378_shuuroku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to include at the end of the volume
- {巻末|かんまつ}⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧: back-matter materials

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {巻頭|かんとう}: beginning of a book — the opposite of {巻末|かんまつ}
- ⟦{末尾|まつび}→末尾：13065_matsubi⟧: the very end — more general; can refer to the end of any text or sequence
- ⟦あとがき→あとがき：21507_atogaki⟧: afterword — a specific type of content often found at the {巻末|かんまつ}
